name: hud_ui_background_cursor_widget_draw_base
description: HudUiBackgroundCursorWidget::DrawBase skips when the captured blit source is null; otherwise it blits that source at the widget x/y with the widget clip rect.
known_limits: Reconstruction remains limited only by Binary Ninja HLIL rendering the same-layout HudUiRect argument as &self->clipRect.left; assembly passes lea [self+0x20], matching the source cast to zVidRect32.
tier_s_evidence: Binary Ninja for 0x4bfc60 loads self->bltSource, skips on null, then passes self->bltSource, self->x, self->y, flags 0, and lea [self+0x20] to zVid_Image::BlitToActiveTarget.
The native smoke verifies null bltSource skips drawing and non-null bltSource blits at x=17/y=23 with the widget clip rect.
